messages:
alex: Heads-up: Black Friday dry-run schedule changed — need a quick decision on backfill regions and whether to prewarm spot pools. TL;DR: 24h prewarm costs ~ $6k, reduces p95 by ~40%.
carla: Do we have region budget for eu-west? Last quarter we barely had spare GPUs.
mike: We have ~120 reserved GPUs in eu-west but autoscaler still caps at 80 per node-pool due to quota. Requesting a quota bump takes ~48h.
alex: @carla @mike thinking: approach A) prewarm reserved in primary region + soft-fail to secondary; B) aggressive cross-region backfill with inter-region routing. Cost vs latency tradeoffs?
julia: Note: KV cache cold-start is the biggest p95 driver. If we warm the cache with synthetic prefixes we can get ~25% improvement without full prewarm — much cheaper.
sre-runbook-bot: deploybot: Canary weights adjusted: region-fallback policy -> enable cross-region fallback = true
mike: Command to spin synthetic warmers (example): ```python scripts/warm_cache.py --model=gpt-small --qps=50 --duration=2h --regions=us-east1,eu-west1``` Run on low-cost preemptible instances. Should we run it now?
carla: Agree to run warmers + small reserved prewarm in eu-west. Estimated cost: $6k prewarm + $800 warmers = $6.8k. Ops time ~2h. I'll file a quick RFC and tag finance for approval.
alex: OK go ahead. @mike can you queue the quota ticket and kick off the warmers? I'll approve the budget. :thumbsup:
mike: On it. Filing quota ticket now (ticket #INC-2342); starting warmers in 5m. Will post progress updates here.
sre-runbook-bot: incidentbot: Note added to incidents channel if backend errors >5% during warm-up.
